programs.name: Air Rifle: Beginner
programs.summary: Safety, stance, breathing and trigger control. No experience needed. All equipment is provided.

programs.name: Air Rifle: Advanced
programs.summary: Competition-focused training: shot analysis, match routines and preparation for state and national events.

programs.name: Air Pistol
programs.summary: One-hand precision shooting: grip, sight alignment and follow-through, coached step by step.

programs.name: Trial Session
programs.summary: Try shooting with a certified coach before you commit. Includes a safety briefing and 30 supervised shots.

events.name: GTRC Club Championship 2026
events.summary: Open club match in 10m Air Rifle and Air Pistol, with Sub-Youth, Youth and Open categories.

events.name: Summer Shooting Camp 2027
events.summary: Two-week holiday camp for children aged 8 to 16, covering fundamentals, fun matches and a certificate.
